latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of JSON Prompt Video Generator Free.

- Generate 30-second AI product videos from uploaded JSON/TXT/CSV/YAML prompts with voiceover and transitions.
- No video editing experience required—upload prompt files (max 200MB) and receive AI-rendered 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic handling of session, authentication (with anonymous token option), and backend connection.
- Cloud GPU-powered video rendering with support for multiple formats (mp4, mov, webm, jpg, png, gif, mp3, etc).
- Built-in user commands for checking credits, exporting videos, status monitoring, and uploading new assets.
- Clear guidance for typical workflows: quick edit, batch processing, iterative refinement.
